toast.stream-deck-control.pairing.title: %s wants to control Minecraft
stream-deck-control.config.title: Stream Deck Control
stream-deck-control.config.pairingCode.t: Enter this code in the Stream Deck app (any Minecraft key's settings). Click for a new code; every paired Stream Deck then has to pair again.
stream-deck-control.config.allowCommands: Lets the "Chat command" key run any command you set on it. Off by default.
stream-deck-control.config.showPairingTo: Shows the pairing code when a Stream Deck that isn't paired yet tries to connect.
stream-deck-control.config.letterboxRati: Picture shape between the black bars. 2.39:1 is the classic widescreen look; 1.85:1 is subtler.
stream-deck-control.config.cinematicHide: Cinematic mode also hides the HUD and your hand, like F1.
stream-deck-control.config.status.off: The local API is not running, see the log
